project: Gantry runner control port and single-host safety

epics.title: Runner control port boundary
epics.objective: Wrap today's local filesystem runner-control protocol without changing behavior.

epics.title: Single-host safety posture
epics.objective: Keep local direct mode but require enforcing sandbox for production/remote and add explicit vertical queue caps.

epics.title: Local behavior regression proof
epics.objective: Prove jobs, live continuations, permissions, browser IPC, and local runner paths remain unchanged.

tasks.title: Add runner control port contracts and filesystem adapter
tasks.objective: Introduce RunnerControlPort and FilesystemRunnerControlPort while keeping auth parsing and handlers in current modules.
acceptance_criteria: Filesystem IPC layout, claim, archive, response, and continuation writes are available through FilesystemRunnerControlPort.
startIpcWatcher and GroupQueue continuation writes still use the same local filesystem paths.
DurableRunnerControlPort has no implementation or bootstrap wiring.
required_tests: adapter preserves pending-file filtering and trusted folder behavior
continuation input and close signal file names remain unchanged
tasks.reviewer_focus: Boundary is a thin adapter, no remote worker behavior, no auth logic moved into transport.

tasks.title: Enforce sandbox posture and add vertical queue caps
tasks.objective: Fail production/remote direct sandbox and add queue backlog caps defaulting to unchanged local behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Local dev may use direct sandbox.
Production or remote posture rejects direct sandbox.
Queue cap defaults of 0 preserve current local behavior.
Positive queue caps reject new backlog without rejecting duplicate running/queued task ids.
tasks.reviewer_focus: Fail-closed production posture, unchanged local defaults, no broad queue behavior rewrite.

tasks.title: Prove durable runner control is contract-only and local IPC still works
tasks.objective: Add architecture and focused local regression tests around runner control.
acceptance_criteria: No remote worker runtime code exists.
Existing permission, browser, task, and continuation IPC tests pass locally.
tasks.reviewer_focus: No accidental remote worker code, unchanged local behavior evidence.
